verdict.rationale: Authy's features page directly claims access 'even [on] your Apple Watch', so the product names this smartwatch surface. The evidence is a single marketing line with no detail on how codes appear on the watch or whether reading them works without handling the phone, and no community report confirms it. missing for 10: documentation of how codes are viewed on the watch, any non-Apple smartwatch (e.g. Wear OS) support, evidence it works without the phone in hand, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: On any device. Your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch.
